bills.title: Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia Bill 2018

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2018-08-23.20.1) moved by South Australian Senator [Anne Ruston](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/sa/anne_ruston) (Liberal), which means it failed. It would have amended an [original amendment ](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2018-08-23.18.1). ### Amendment > *Omit "15 April 2019", substitute "1 November 2018".* ### Original amendment > *At the end of the motion, add:* > > *"and, in respect of the provisions of the Federal Circuit and Family court of Australia Bill 2018 and the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia (Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2018, the Legal and Constitutional Affairs Legislation Committee report by 15 April 2019".*
